publications.title: A Hybrid Generative Reduced-Order Model for the Minimal Flow Unit

ai_results.summary: Couples a β-VAE-GAN with a sensor-conditioned Easy Attention Transformer to forecast near-wall turbulence from three point sensors. Published in Int. J. Heat Fluid Flow.

publications.title: VIVALDy: A Hybrid Generative Reduced-Order Model for Turbulent Flows, Applied to Vortex-Induced Vibrations

ai_results.summary: Introduces VIVALDy, combining β-VAE-GAN and bidirectional transformer for reduced-order modelling of VIV systems from cylinder displacement alone. Published in Physical Review Fluids.

publications.title: Data-driven modeling of near-wall turbulence using β-variational autoencoder, transformers, and adversarial loss

ai_results.summary: β-VAE-GAN + transformer framework for near-wall turbulence in a minimal channel at Re_τ=200; predicts latent dynamics within one Lyapunov time. Presented at THMT-25, Tokyo.

publications.title: Simulation of a wingtip vortex flow with Linear Eddy Viscosity turbulence models at Re=4.6E6 and Re=1.2E6

ai_results.summary: RANS simulation of a wingtip vortex with linear eddy-viscosity models; compares turbulence closure performance for vortex roll-up prediction.
